title: StarkweatherOFC-CCEP: orbitofrontal cortico-cortical evoked potential recordings, 7 patients (Starkweather et al.) (derivative)
description: Preprocessed intracranial EEG recordings from the orbitofrontal cortex of 7 patients undergoing single-pulse electrical stimulation for cortico-cortical evoked potential (CCEP) mapping. The derivative dataset provides per-electrode timeseries, both unreferenced and bipolar-referenced, sampled at 1000 Hz, along with stimulation event times and amplitudes. It supports study of effective connectivity and homotopic communication between human orbitofrontal subregions.
methods_description: Authors' preprocessed per-electrode timeseries (unreferenced and bipolar) at 1000 Hz were repackaged as BrainVision float32 files in microvolts. Single-pulse stimulation times and amplitudes were written to events.tsv. Sulcus-relative electrode distances are provided in electrodes.tsv, and the original release files are kept in sourcedata.
